_comment: Copy to st-config.json on the player's storage root. Absent or 0 means this device does NOT run a server - which is the default, because exactly one box per site should host one.
_payloadUrl: Where the server package comes from. Point this at your own host (normally <your server>/scripts/server-payload.zip) so a site does not reach across the internet to us to update software running on its own hardware. If unset, the launcher uses serverUrl below, or the server_url in a screentinker.json on this storage root, and only then alpha.screentinker.com. The launcher reads <payloadUrl with .zip swapped for .json> to learn what version is published and its sha256, so both files must sit together. Do not put credentials in this URL; if you must, they are redacted from logs and the status screen.
_serverUrl: Optional. The ScreenTinker server this box belongs to; used to build the payload URL when payloadUrl is not set.
_allowInsecurePayloadUrl: The payload is code this box runs, so it must come over https://. Plain http:// is accepted only for LAN hosts (private/loopback IPs, single-label names, .local/.lan/.internal/.home.arpa). Set true ONLY if you accept that anyone on the network path can replace the server this box runs. Redirects from https to http are refused regardless.
_autoUpdate: true (default) checks that manifest on every boot and installs a different version. Set false to pin this box to whatever it already has. A failed check or a failed update NEVER stops the installed server from starting.
_updateCheckHours: How often a RUNNING box asks whether a newer payload has been published. 24 by default; 0 checks only at boot. The check downloads the small manifest, not the package. When something new is published the box REBOOTS so the boot path installs it - the server runs inside the launcher process, so it cannot be replaced underneath itself. Each published payload is worth exactly one reboot: if the install does not take, the box stays where it is and says so in .payload-install.log rather than rebooting every day. autoUpdate:false disables this regardless of the value here.
